description.value: 50th Parallel Estate Winery is an internationally award-winning Okanagan estate winery specializing in Pinot Noir and aromatic wines, set on a vineyard above Lake Country. The property includes underground wine caves, a tasting room open seven days a week, and Block One — a fine-dining restaurant focused on regional-seasonal ingredients that has been recognized as one of Canada's top restaurants. Event facilities accommodate groups from 10 to 350, making this a notable destination stop on any Okanagan cycling route.
